punchline: The authors split a leader's day into above the line and below it, and the difference is not skill.
thirty_sec: In this book on conscious leadership, a leader is always either above the line or below it. Below, you are closed, defensive and committed to being right. Above, you are open, curious and committed to learning. Nobody lives above the line all the time, so the first step is just to notice which side you are on and say so.
